turns.text: Hello, this is Northwheel’s AI assistant. I can answer workshop questions or take a message for the team.
We’re closed on Saturday. The nearest open day is Monday from 09:00 to 17:00. Would you like to leave a message for staff to follow up?
Tell me about your bicycle services.
Actually, can you guarantee my repair today?

We do puncture repairs and basic bicycle servicing, but repair timing has to be confirmed by staff, so I can’t guarantee a repair today. We’re also closed today. Would you like to leave your name, phone number, and what you need so the team can follow up?
Do you repair Vintage Espresso Machines?
I don’t have any information about espresso-machine repairs. Northwheel handles puncture repairs and basic bicycle servicing only. If you’d like, I can take a message for the team about a bike issue.
Please take a message. I am Alex Example. I would like the team to confirm repair timing. I will contact the workshop myself. So I will not give a phone number.

Got it, I’ve noted a message for Alex Example asking the team to confirm repair timing, with no phone number provided because you’ll contact the workshop yourself. Please reach out to them when it’s convenient for you.
